component.name: Noter
component.summary: Write and find local Markdown notes

description.p: Noter is a local-first Markdown note app with a flat, searchable collection, lightweight tags, recoverable deletion, and user-owned backups.
Write Markdown notes privately on your computer, find them with Search, and export a Backup you own. Rendered Preview and Split recommend WebKitGTK 6.

Native alpha presents the 1.0 Markdown Note App: Search, Tags with Edit tags and collection autocomplete, recoverable delete, paper-neutral About/help/confirmations, Backup Import Preview, Storage Recovery, Preview and 50/50 Split, and web-to-desktop transition restore. Collection data lives under the XDG application id net.astrazds.Noter. The first shippable native artifact is an x86_64 AppImage. Not a 2.0.0 release.
